proxy_invalid: partners.proxy in hub.json doesn’t read (http://, https://, socks5:// or socks5h://, a host and a port), so partner hubs aren’t dialed
proxy_none: Partner hubs are dialed only through a proxy (partners.proxy_always), but no proxy applies to the partner hub’s addresses
credentials_unreadable: Can’t read the partner hub’s credentials: {err}
refused: The partner hub doesn’t accept this hub’s credentials (it may have unpaired). Pair again
partner_off: The partner hub has partner hubs turned off
partner_member: The partner hub is now a member of a linked-hubs group, so it has no partner hubs
no_tls_address: No secure address or key for the partner hub: this hub waits for it to connect
